description: Port the requested qr_mega_la_tc structure into the fish n=512 path as a low-footprint one-CTA look-ahead megakernel: replace WMMA with native sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM plus TMA, stream 128-column tiles, retain FP32 panel/T arithmetic and compensated TF32 updates, and cut the old 210 KiB shared-memory footprint.

Build a cluster-tiled n=512 single-launch QR megakernel: four CTAs per matrix, an FP32 NB=16 panel producer publishing compact-WY V/T through DSM, and CTAs updating independent 128-column tiles via cta_group::1 tcgen05/TMA between cluster barriers while preserving hard-case routing and compact Householder output.

Build a resident grid-wide n=512 QR megakernel that fuses FP32 Householder panels with tiled compact-WY updates without sacrificing GPU-wide parallelism: keep V/T in global slabs, schedule 128-column tcgen05/TMA update tasks through a device work queue, and use safe fully-resident phase barriers plus compensated TF32 arithmetic.
